::: {#rem-well-ordering}
#### Smallest elements

These notes use one more fact about the integers without proving it
[@wikipedia_well_ordering_principle]:

- every set of positive integers that has at least one element has a smallest element.

For example, the set of positive integers $b$ for which $\frac{3}{4} b$ is an integer
has the elements $4$, $8$, $12$ and so on,
and its smallest element is $4$.

:::
